key.name: target-player
key.description: Target media player: 'all' for all MPRIS players with Spotify prioritized, or 'spotify' for Spotify exclusively

key.name: pill-position
key.description: Position in the GNOME top bar: 'center', 'left', or 'right'

key.name: pill-display-mode
key.description: Display mode in the compact pill: 'lyrics' for live singing lyrics line, or 'title' for song title and artist

key.name: show-visualizer
key.description: Whether to show animated equalizer bars on the compact pill during playback

key.name: enable-ambient-glow
key.description: Whether to sample dominant album art color and project ambient tint on the compact pill and card rim

key.name: card-background-style
key.description: Style of card background: 'cover-art' for album cover with vignette fade, 'ambient' for ambient color gradient, or 'black' for pure pitch black

key.name: progress-style
key.description: Style of music progress bar: 'wavy' for Samsung OneUI sound-reactive wave, or 'straight' for clean straight bar
